_doc: The Trail's upgrade icons (pass 129): one row an icon, one style for the whole set. tools/gen_icon_cands.py reads this file: each row is the job trail_<id> (kind trail), painted by Flux.2 Klein on the green screen (screen blue for a green subject), candidates in tools/dl/icons_trail/, a pick installed into game/art/ui/trail/<id>.png (256 px, transparent). Paint: python tools/gen_icon_cands.py --only trail_might,trail_plate --seeds 3 ; pick: python tools/gen_icon_cands.py --pick trail_might=1 . 'for' is what the upgrade does (docs/trail_schema.md, the upgrades table); the tool never reads it.
style: Bold mobile game UI upgrade emblem: one single object, chunky and simplified with big shapes and no small detail, a very thick dark outline of even weight around the whole silhouette, flat cel shading with one bright highlight, smooth clean surfaces with no texture and no scratches, bright saturated warm colors, centered and filling about 80% of the frame, readable as a silhouette at thumbnail size, no text, no letters, no numbers, nothing holding it, no background, no scene
